text: Don't you worry, Dad, I am the Brooklyn Boss 父 亲 进 城
INT. PRESS CONFERENCE - DAY1 1

A major news network reports on the Weston Group’s successful investments. NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)All eyes are on the Weston Group this afternoon as the New York Stock Exchange closing bell rang. Surrounded by bodyguards and accosted by reporters and camera flashes, ISABELLE ANNE WESTON (28, blonde, business suit) walks up onto the stage, With a confident smile on her face. Close up of the action. NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)And here we see the CEO of the Weston Group, Miss Weston, the youngest female entrepreneur in Los Angeles whose net worth has now exceeded 100 billion dollars.
EXT. A DINING CAR - DAY 2 2

We are watching this news report from the screen of an old smartphone. JERRY WESTON (59, wearing an apron and oven mitts) watches the news on his phone screen with three other customers. CUSTOMER 1Jerry, you old dog, your daughter is going places! CUSTOMER 2(jealous)Look at her, walking side by side with the governor, Isabelle is no ordinary entrepreneur! The oven timer dings. Jerry wraps up a freshly made wrap and hands it to the customers. JERRYMy humble little shop is so out of the way, I rarely get any business.

But it’s all thanks to loyal customers like you that I was able to raise my daughter to be the woman she is now. The customers try to pay, but Jerry stops them. JERRY(CONT’D)No, no, it’s on the house today. Jerry’s cell phone rings, it’s Isabelle. JERRY(CONT’D)Oh, Isabelle is calling. Jerry takes off his oven mitts and picks up the phone. His customers lean in to listen.

Cross cutting between two locations Out on the terrace, Isabelle holds her cellphone to her ear. ISABELLEDad, I bought an apartment in Brooklyn so you can move out of that old and shabby house. Come live with me. Back to the stand, Jerry’s customers nod in agreement with Isabelle. Jerry sighs. JERRYThat’s too much trouble. Brooklyn? Forget it, I wouldn’t be comfortable living in a place like that. Out on the terrace. ISABELLEDad, ever since Mom passed away, I’ve been worried about you living all by yourself back home. Back to the stand, Jerry’s fighting a losing battle. JERRYI’m getting used to it, living on my own.

ISABELLE (V.O.)Please, Dad, just listen. You’re so old now, it’s time for me to take care of you. I’m always worried because you’re so far away. I’ll come pick you up tomorrow, okay? With his customers silently urging him on to agree, Jerry is left with no choice. JERRYIf you put it that way...alright. I’ll also take the opportunity to visit you and your fiancé.(pause)But you’re so busy with work, you don’t need to come pick me up. I can find my own way. Out on the terrace. ISABELLEAre you sure? Back to the stand. JERRYIt’s Weston Building, how could I miss it? Don’t worry about me. But can you do me one favor? ISABELLESay the word and consider it done. JERRYYou know me, I can’t sit still for more than a minute. If I’m going to live with you in Brooklyn, I’ll need something to help pass the time. Or else I’ll die of boredom. ISABELLEI’m sure we can figure something out. It’s settled then, you’re definitely coming here. Bye! JERRYGoodbye, dear. Jerry hangs up the phone. His customers congratulate him. CUSTOMER 1Incredible, you’re going to have a great time!
CUSTOMER 2Safe travels, Jerry! Keep in touch! Jerry looks down, embarrassed but pleased.
Jerry packs some cheese and wraps into an old, worn cloth bag.

He lets out a sigh of relief and looks over at a table displaying old photos. He sees a family photo of younger versions of him, Isabelle, and his wife. He walks over to the table sadly and picks up a black and white portrait of his wife. JERRY(wiping away tears)Emma, our daughter Isabelle has become so successful, come with me so we can enjoy the fruits of our labor together! Jerry takes out his cellphone and removes his clear phone case. He puts Emma’s portrait between the phone and phone case. Moonlight shines in through the window. Jerry looks up and out the window, looking forward to the future with a bright smile.
INT. SUBWAY - DAY5 5

The subway arrives at the station where Jerry stands waiting, his cloth bag slung over his shoulder. The door opens and just as Jerry is about to step on, a group of young people push past him to get on. Jerry stumbles as he’s pushed along by the crowd and almost falls over. Jerry finds an empty corner inside the train where he can stand. He puts down his bag, sweating but looking happy. JERRY (V.O.)Soon, I’ll see my daughter again.

BRITTANY MORGAN (27, dressed in a miniskirt and black stockings), TIFFANY HILTON (27, dressed in a miniskirt and nude stockings) walk into the car. CLOSE UP: their slim figures and long legs They stand in the middle of the car. Brittany sees Jerry in the corner and frowns, wrinkling her nose in disgust, but she shakes it off. TIFFANYThis sucks, I can’t believe our car broke down and now we have to take the subway. BRITTANY It doesn’t matter. What really matters is this deal with the Weston Group. If we can secure this deal, we’re looking at hundreds of millions of dollars in profit. We can’t make a single mistake. TIFFANY(bumps hips with Brittany)Don’t worry, we got this! They smile at each other. BRITTANY(covering her mouth)Ugh, what’s that smell? Tiffany sniffs and pinches her nose. Brittany notices Jerry in the corner, looks him up and down, then gestures towards him. Tiffany looks over at Jerry too and notices his bag. TIFFANYBrooklyn is such a mess. The subway is already dirty enough, but now they’re even letting homeless people into the trains? (loud and aggressive towards Jerry)Hey! You over there with the bag of garbage! How gross can you get?
INT. SUBWAY - DAY6 6

Aerial shot: Subway gate Jerry smiles and walks towards Brittany and Tiffany. JERRYNo, ladies, this isn’t garbage. This is homemade cheese, a special family recipe. It’s my daughter’s favorite, especially when I bake it in a wrap. Jerry takes a small wrap out of his bag and offers it to Tiffany with a smile. JERRY(CONT’D)It’s delicious, would you like to try some? Tiffany is disgusted and knocks the wrap out of Jerry’s hand. TIFFANYEw! Get that away from me! The wrap splatters everywhere. The other passengers look down at him with contempt, moving away to avoid him. Jerry scrambles on all fours in a panic, trying to pick up the pieces of wrap. He leaves his phone face down on the ground beside him. JERRYOh no! This is my daughter’s favorite! Brittany scoffs. BRITTANYLook at yourself. Bums like you don’t have the right to get on the subway with us. TIFFANYYou’ve turned this place into homeless shelter! Jerry stands up angrily.

JERRYI bought a ticket! I have a right to take this train. Passenger 1 stands up from their seat. PASSENGER 1Hey, stop bullying that poor old man. Come sit over here with me! Passenger 2 joins in. PASSENGER 2Yeah, you should both be ashamed of yourselves, screaming and shouting like that in public. Passenger 3 shouts angrily. PASSENGER 3You think you own this train or something? If you don’t like it here, just get off! Tiffany is furious and steps forward to start a fight with Passenger 3, Brittany stops her. BRITTANYWhatever, don’t stoop down to their level. Tiffany’s reluctant to let it go, but then she notices Jerry’s cellphone on the ground.

The camera side of the phone is facing upwards Tiffany shrieks, jumps up and dodges away from the camera. TIFFANYOh my god! Someone’s trying to take pictures up our skirts! Jerry reaches down automatically and picks up his phone. Tiffany points at Jerry accusingly. TIFFANY(CONT’D)(venomously)It’s you! You perverted old man! You were trying to take photos of us.
Jerry holds up his cellphone in a panic, shocked and confused.
INT. SUBWAY - DAY7 7

Tiffany snatches Jerry’s phone and starts swiping through it violently. TIFFANYI want to see how many other girls you’ve been secretly taking pictures of. JERRY(anxious)I wasn’t trying to do anything like that! I was just picking things up and accidentally dropped my phone. Brittany crosses her arms and sneers at him. BRITTANYYou’re just making up excuses. I can see right through you. You just wanted to take photos up our skirts. Old scoundrels like you are all the same. TIFFANY(pointing at Jerry angrily)Yeah, you tried to pick up the phone after we caught you. You’ve obviously done this before! Jerry keeps shaking his head, trying to deny their accusations, but the other passengers begin to side with Brittany and Tiffany. PASSENGER 1So that’s the kind of person you are! We were wrong about those poor girls. PASSENGER 2(disgusted)Look at his clothes! And he smells! Maybe he’s a fugitive!

PASSENGER 3(stands up and spits at Jerry)Such indecency! The passengers all stand up, insulting and shaming Jerry. Jerry desperately tries to explain, but no one listens to him. The passengers' insults and angry faces overwhelm Jerry until his vision blurs and there’s a ringing in his ears. He becomes dizzy and can barely stay upright. JERRY(Desperately)It’s not true, it’s really not true, I was just picking something up and my phone fell onto the ground. I wasn’t trying to take photos of anyone! BRITTANYYou won’t admit it? Of course you wouldn’t, you’re a criminal through and through! Jerry staggers forward and begs Tiffany for his phone back. JERRYPlease, miss, give my phone back. My daughter won’t be able to find me if I lose my phone. Brittany and Tiffany ignore Jerry as he continues to beg them. JERRY(CONT’D)(Anxiously)Please, please, give my phone back! TIFFANY(screeching)We’re not giving it back! This has all the evidence! Tell the truth, how many girls have you been secretly taking pictures of? Jerry wipes sweat off his forehead.
Miss, I’m old enough to be your father, I would never do such a thing!

Tiffany boxes Jerry’s ear and knocks him to the ground. TIFFANYYou pervert, you’re nothing like my dad! Jerry falls painfully, still trying to explain himself. JERRY(crying)I’m not, I’m not... BRITTANYI see now! This crazy old man is a predator! He comes onto the subway so he can assault women! The passengers all look at Jerry, who is still helplessly on the ground.
INT. SUBWAY - DAY8 8

Passenger 4 stands up. PASSENGER 4Don’t give him back his phone! Passenger 5 steps forward. PASSENGER 5(indignant)If he really is taking pictures up girls’ skirts, that’s a crime. We have to call the police and make sure he’s arrested! Passenger 6 laughs mockingly. PASSENGER 6Hurry and check his photo album for the pictures. Once we bring him to the police he won’t be able to deny it! BRITTANY(to Jerry)What’s your password?

TIFFANY(viciously)Come on! Let us check your photos. Jerry steps back, scared and anxious. Brittany changes tactics, she coaxes Jerry in a gentle but sinister voice. BRITTANYDon’t be scared, just tell us. And if you really didn’t take any photos, we’ll give your phone back. JERRY(hesitantly)...alright. If you promise you’ll give it back. Brittany nods impatiently. JERRY(CONT’D)The password is 123456. The other passengers crowd around Brittany to watch as she unlocks the phone and searches through his photos.

She doesn’t find anything in the photo album. PASSENGER 1There’s nothing here! PASSENGER 2No photos at all! Brittany and Tiffany look at each other in surprise. The other passengers awkwardly return to their seats. Jerry sighs in relief. JERRYSee? No photos. Now please can you give my phone back? Jerry reaches out for his phone. Brittany reluctantly begins to return the phone, but Tiffany suddenly grabs it. TIFFANYHold on! Tiffany turns the phone over, revealing the black and white photo inside of his phone case.

TIFFANY(CONT’D)You said there were no photos, but look, what’s this? The other passengers begin to murmur amongst themselves. Jerry panics and rushes forward to get his phone back. JERRY(urgently)That’s the only photo I have left of my wife. Please give it back. Brittany pushes Jerry away. Tiffany sneers, taking the photo out of the phone case. TIFFANYWife? How could an ugly old loser like you have such a young and beautiful wife? You must have stolen this picture to jerk off with! Brittany and the other passengers laugh at him mockingly. JERRYThat really is my wife, please give it back!(pause)I’ll do anything, anything you ask me to do, just please give it back! BRITTANY(laughing)He said he’s willing to do anything you ask him to do! Hahahaha! TIFFANYAlright then, if you lick all that disgusting cheese or whatever off of the floor, the walls, and my shoes, then I’ll give this back to you. Jerry is horrified by the request, but desperate. Brittany and Tiffany share a look of triumph.
INT. SUBWAY - DAY9 9

Jerry backs away helplessly. The other passengers start to boo. They yell at him, voices overlapping each other. PASSENGERSLick it up!/Hurry up and do it!/ Lick it!/ You still wanna take photos, huh? / Get down on your knees and lick it! Jerry's eyes lose focus, his knees are weak and he falls to the ground. He leans down and CLOSE UP his mouth is about to touch the subway floor. In the background, we hear Tiffany, Brittany, and the other passengers laughing at him. TIFFANY (O.S.)Hey, you stupid old bastard, look over here! Jerry looks up and sees Tiffany grinning as she tears up the picture of his wife and throws the wrapes onto the ground in front of him. Jerry loses all self control. He jumps up and rushes toward Tiffany. JERRYThat’s my wife! How could you! Tiffany screams and dodges him, causing Jerry’s hand to land close to her chest. Passenger A joins in and kicks Jerry to the ground. TIFFANYYou pervert! Now you’re trying to molest me in front of everyone?! Jerry picks himself up onto his hands and knees. JERRY(crying)No! No! I didn’t! Jerry tries to grab onto Passenger 6’s thigh, asking for help

JERRY(CONT’D)You saw what happened, right? I didn’t do it! Passenger 6 shakes him off. PASSENGER 6How shameless can you be, you old bastard? His children would be ashamed of him. PASSENGER 4He said he has a daughter. She’s probably a slut! PASSENGER 2Crazy hobos like him deserve to starve on the streets. Tiffany looks out the window then looks back at Jerry TIFFANYAlright, we’re almost at our stop. I don’t have any time to waste on a pervert like you. But I will teach you a lesson! Tiffany smashes Jerry’s phone onto the ground.
Jerry’s look of despair.
INT. SUBWAY - DAY10 10
Shattered on the ground. SUBWAY CONDUCTOR (V.O.)This is Bedford Ave. The next stop is Lorimer St. Stand clear of the closing doors. Brittany and Tiffany walk out of the train triumphantly.

TIFFANYCome on, Brittany. We have a contract to sign with Miss Weston. We can’t waste any more time with this old wrapes of trash! The other passengers get off the train one after another, leaving Jerry alone in the car, with the torn up photograph scattered all over the floor. Jerry picks up his broken cellphone from the ground, trying to press the buttons, but it doesn’t respond. Jerry puts the broken phone into his pocket and starts gathering up the torn photograph wrapes. He looks down at the shredded wrapes, tears of despair and hatred flowing down his face.
EXT. STREET - DAY11 11

Tiffany walks quickly ahead while Brittany follows. They chat as they walk. BRITTANY(relaxed)Don’t worry! My cousin is Miss Weston’s fiancé. With him on our side, this deal is as good as ours. Tiffany slows down. TIFFANY(excited)I heard that Miss Weston isn’t just incredibly talented, she’s also gorgeous enough to be a model. BRITTANY(yearning)Yeah, she is. Beautiful and business savvy. My cousin must’ve used up a lifetime of luck to get engaged to her. (checks her watch)We’re wasting time, let’s go! Brittany takes out a foundation compact and touches up her makeup as they walk. In the compact mirror, she notices Jerry standing on the side of the road with his bag on his back. BRITTANY(CONT’D)Hey, is that loser following us?
Tiffany looks over, surprised.
EXT. STREET - DAY12 12

Without any warning, Tiffany turns around and shoves Jerry. TIFFANYWhat do you want, you old hobo? Following us around to sneak up on us? Jerry retreats helplessly. JERRYI’m not following you, I’m looking for my daughter. Tiffany looks him over and threatens him viciously TIFFANYYou watch yourself. If you try anything, I’ll have someone break your legs! Brittany pulls Tiffany away. BRITTANYForget about him, we have to get to the Weston Group! Jerry is slightly surprised JERRY(mumbles to himself)Weston Group? A luxury RR car suddenly drives towards them. Brittany is delighted to see it. BRITTANYThat’s Miss Weston’s car! TIFFANY(excited)Did she come to pick us up? Brittany tugs Tiffany back, trying to calm her down. BRITTANYDon’t be silly, we’re not important enough for that.

The luxury RR car drives past the two girls and stops in front of Jerry. The girls’ faces fall. TIFFANYOh my god, is miss Weston here to pick up this old guy? Brittany and Tiffany are shocked. Jerry smiles in relief.
EXT. STREET - DAY13 13

The luxury RR car stops and a man dressed in a plain looking suit gets out of the driver’s seat. Brittany and Tiffany let out sighs of relief. BRITTANYOf course. There are Rolls-Royces everywhere. It’d be a crazy coincidence if this was actual Miss Weston’s car. Tiffany spits at Jerry. TIFFANYYou useless old trash, as if anyone would come pick you up in a car like this. Dream on! Jerry shakes his head helplessly. Brittany checks her phone. BRITTANYTiffany, hurry up! The Weston Group manager is waiting for us! Brittany pulls Tiffany along and they walk away quickly. As soon as they’re gone, the man in the suit opens the passenger door and helps Isabelle out of the car. Isabelle hurries over to Jerry and holds his hands in hers. ISABELLE(excited)Dad!
JERRY(excited)Isabelle. Isabelle notices the bruise on Jerry’s face. ISABELLEDad, what happened to your face?

JERRY (V.O.)I can’t tell Isabelle what happened. If she loses her temper, she could destroy their lives if she wanted to. I’ll give those girls a second chance. JERRY(covering his face)It’s nothing, it was an accident. Isabelle takes her phone out, ready to make a call. ISABELLE(urgent)That’s not nothing! It looks serious. Let’s go to the hospital. Jerry stops Isabelle from making the call. JERRY(playing it off)It’s ok, really, just a little bruise. (changes the subject)Come on, let’s go! Isabelle helps Jerry into the car and gestures to the man in the suit. He takes jerry’s bag and puts it in the trunk. Isabelle and Jerry chat and laugh as they get in the car. ISABELLELook how much you have to carry just to visit me! You must be exhausted.
JERRYI brought all your favorites, my cheese, wraps
ISABELLE(laughing)Yes, my favorite. Dad’s homemade wraps.
EXT. STREET - DAY14 14

Brittany and Tiffany are walking on the street, chatting and laughing with each other. Isabelle’s luxury car drives past. The backseat window is open. Tiffany sees Jerry through the open window. Tiffany’s smile freezes instantly. Before she can react, the car drives away. She grabs Brittany's arm wildly. TIFFANYBrittany, I think I’m losing my mind. I just saw that old guy sitting in a BMW!
EXT. STREET - DAY15 15

Brittany looks over her shoulder, but nothing is there. BRITTANYThat’s impossible. You must’ve imagined it. TIFFANYBut... BRITTANYStop it, you’re being crazy, let’s hurry up. Brittany pulls Tiffany forward. TIFFANY(in disbelief)I’m not being crazy, I really saw him in the car! Brittany is helpless. BRITTANYWhat’re you talking about. There’s BMWs everywhere. Come on, the manager is waiting for us!
Brittany pulls Tiffany along, but she’s still distracted and looking around for the BMW to prove that she’s right. TIFFANY(mumbling)I really saw him....
EXT. WESTON GROUP BUILDING TERRACE - DAY24

Isabelle is giving instructions to her handsome secretary, JACOB. ISABELLEAnd you let our security department know that my dad is here, right? JACOB(respectfully)Of course, Miss Weston. I let our Head of Security know this morning. Isabelle nods, satisfied. She is about to leave, but then suddenly remembers something. ISABELLEAlso, I wanted to have him work as a cook- JACOBI gave the cafeteria manager a heads up, he’ll set your father up with everything he needs whenever he’s ready to get started. Isabelle pats Jacob’s shoulder approvingly. She leaves.
INT. WESTON GROUP BUILDING LOBBY - DAY16 16

Brittany and Tiffany enter the lobby. SPENCER MILES approaches them slowly. SPENCERHello, you must be Miss Morgan, General Manager of Skyline. Come in, come in. Welcome to the Weston Group! BRITTANYYes, that’s me. And you are? Spencer looks them up and down and leers at the girls. SPENCERMy name is Spencer Miles, I am the planning manager of Weston Group. Miss Weston considers this deal between our companies a very high priority so she asked me to welcome you in person. Tiffany rolls her eyes. TIFFANY (V.O.)This Spencer guy seems lame, but it sounds like he’s pretty high up there. This is my chance to make a good first impression. Tiffany reaches out for a handshake and winks at Spencer. TIFFANYThank you so much for meeting with us, Mr. Miles! Spencer leers at Tiffany and squeezes her hand gently. Tiffany pulls her hand back with a smile. Brittany remains oblivious. BRITTANYThis deal is a high priority for us over at Skyline as well.

We’ve put a lot of time and effort into making this happen, so please we would really appreciate if you could put in a good word for us with Miss Weston. SPENCEROf course I will. BRITTANY(suddenly remembering)By the way, my cousin should be here soon. SPENCER(confused)Your cousin? BRITTANY(proudly)Miss Weston’s fiancé. Spencer is shocked, the gears in his head spinning rapidly. SPENCER (V.O.)They’re directly related to Miss Weston’s fiancé! I have to make sure they’re taken care of. Spencer becomes especially attentive and flattering.

Well if that’s the case you don’t need anything from me. I’m sure this deal with proceed without any issues. Did you have a long commute? Next time you need to visit us, please let me know and I’ll pick you up myself! Tiffany curls her lip. TIFFANYUgh, don’t remind me! We had to take the subway, and this gross old pervert tried to take pictures up our skirts with his phone. SPENCEROh god! Tiffany glances at Brittany.

I mean, it’s not the first time something like this has happened. Brittany has both looks and a great figure, There’s always some awful pervert trying to come after her. As Tiffany gets herself worked up, Brittany looks more and more pleased. TIFFANY(CONT’D)(covering up her chest)But that awful old man, he was the worst! Not only did he take pictures up our skirts, he also pretended to fall and molested me! Spencer is outraged.

How could he! Tell me what he looks like. I’ll send people out to track him down. He needs to apologize to you for such a crime! TIFFANY(trying to remember)Oh I can barely remember... As Tiffany is trying to remember, she notices the elevator doors opening. She sees Isabelle helping Jerry into the elevator. TIFFANY(CONT’D)(shocked and excited)That’s him!
INT. WESTON GROUP BUILDING LOBBY - DAY17 17
Brittany looks over at Tiffany. BRITTANY(confused)What’s wrong, Tiffany? Tiffany blinks furiously and looks over at the elevators again, but there’s no one there.

TIFFANY(holding her head)Am I seeing things?(frustrated)What is going on with me? Brittany pats Tiffany’s back soothingly and turns to Spencer. BRITTANYAnyway Mr. Miles, weren’t you saying you would help us teach that old geezer a lesson? I remember now, he was in his 60s, white hair and beard, wearing dirty rags for clothes. And he was holding a bag full of disgusting wraps and cheese. You could smell him a mile away. TIFFANYYes he smelled awful! And he had creepy look in his eyes. SPENCERYou did say he was a perverted old man, so it must be true. TIFFANYI think he said he worked in a dinning car. Maybe he was applying to work as a cook here? Spencer considers. SPENCER (V.O.)Miss Weston did hire a new chef to work in the cafeteria recently, but it couldn’t be any of them! SPENCERI know just how to find him, ladies, don’t worry. And when I do, I’ll bring him to you right away so he can be brought to justice. Tiffany winks at Spencer and he smirks in response. TIFFANYYou work so hard! Let’s go to Miss Weston now, we have a contract to sign! SPENCERFollow me, please.
INT. WESTON GROUP OFFICE - DAY18 18

Jerry is wearing his chef’s uniform and looks at himself in the mirror. JERRYIsabelle really knows what she’s doing. Working here as a chef is making the best use of my experience and abilities. Jerry sits down on the chair behind the desk and closes his eyes to rest.
INT. OUTSIDE WESTON GROUP OFFICE - DAY 19
Spencer leads Brittany and Tiffany to the door. SPENCERThis is Miss Weston’s office. Spencer knocks carefully.
INT. WESTON GROUP OFFICE - DAY20 20

Jerry is still resting inside with his eyes closed. His back is facing the door. He hears the knock on the door. JERRYCome in! The door opens. Spencer invites Brittany and Tiffany into the office. They enter and look around. They see the chair behind the desk. TIFFANY(cautiously)Miss Weston? Jerry turns the chair around abruptly. Brittany and Tiffany are shocked to see Jerry. Jerry is similarly surprised to see the girls. FLASHBACK SCENES OF BRITTANY AND TIFFANY BULLYING JERRY ON THE SUBWAY Tiffany is so startled she almost falls over. BRITTANYYou...you’re sitting in Miss Weston’s chair? How?
INT. WESTON GROUP OFFICE - DAY21 21

JERRYOh, it’s you. Brittany starts bowing nonstop, trying to apologize. BRITTANYI’m so sorry, I didn’t know you had connections to Miss Weston. We were wrong, we’re so sorry! Tiffany is terrified of her mistakes and slaps herself in the face. TIFFANY(upset)We were crazy to say you’re old and smelly, you’re obviously very handsome! BRITTANYOur deal with Miss Weston is very very important, please don’t tell Miss Weston about what we did. Spencer steps in to stop Brittany and Tiffany. SPENCERWhat are you doing? This man has nothing to do with Miss Weston. I don’t recognize him at all. Brittany and Tiffany regain their arrogance instantly. TIFFANY (V.O.)What? Spencer doesn’t recognize him? So we’re not in trouble at all! Brittany stands up straight and glares at Jerry. Jerry stands up from the chair and tries to explain himself. JERRYActually, I am- Spencer interrupts Jerry. SPENCER(aggressive)You must be the new cafeteria cook.

It’s only your first day and you had the audacity to break into Miss Weston’s office. You even sat in her chair! Are you insane? BRITTANYHarassing us on the subway wasn’t enough for you, huh? You even followed us here! Tiffany notices his bag on the ground and also starts yelling. TIFFANYI bet he’s here to steal things. Check his bag! Brittany, Tiffany, and Spencer exchange a look and rush forward to snatch his bag. Jerry grabs his bag and clutches it to himself protectively. JERRYI’m not a thief! My daughter asked me to wait here for her. My daughter, Isabelle Weston! Brittany, Tiffany, and Spencer are frozen in shock. BRITTANYWhat?!
INT. WESTON GROUP OFFICE - DAY22 22

BRITTANYWe’re screwed. We’re screwed! TIFFANY(incredulous)Are you really Miss Weston’s father? Brittany is panicking. BRITTANY (V.O.)Our deal is ruined! Spencer inspects Jerry critically, eyeing his uniform.

Miss Weston is a magnanimous person and would take care of her parents. She would never let her father work here as a cook. BRITTANYThat’s true! And her father would never be the kind of person who takes public transportation to get here. TIFFANYHe can’t be Miss Weston’s father, he’s lying! Brittany looks at his bag and sneers. BRITTANYHe even said that gross cheese was for his daughter, but someone as rich as me or Miss Weston would never eat something like that. JERRYBut my daughter really does like this, her fiancé does too! BRITTANYOh, please. Miss Weston’s fiancé is my cousin. I’ve never heard him say he likes eating anything like this. JERRYBut... TIFFANY(excitedly)Enough with your lies already! Mr. Miles, he’s a thief! Quick, grab him! Spencer grabs Jerry, who tries to resist futilely, and slams him down on the desk. SPENCERThink you can steal from us, huh? What did you take? Tell me! Jerry winces in pain and takes out his cellphone.
JERRYI’m not a thief! If you don’t believe me, call my daughter!
INT. WESTON GROUP OFFICE - DAY 23 23

Spencer hesitates for a moment, then lets Jerry up off the desk. Spencer takes Jerry’s cellphone suspiciously and tries to use it to make a call. He tries to turn it on, but the screen stays black. Spencer throws the phone down angrily and grabs Jerry by the collar. SPENCERYou sneaky son of a bitch, you think you can trick me with a broken phone? He punches Jerry twice. Jerry falls to the ground. He picks up his phone and tries to turn it on. JERRY(helpless)My phone is broken? Jerry points at Brittany and Tiffany. JERRY(CONT’D)You! You broke my phone when we were in the subway! TIFFANYMr. Miles, he’s lying! He’s crazy! You need to call security and get him out of here! Spencer drags Jerry off the ground and sneers.
